zones.name: Khori Gaon, Faridabad
zones.event: Supreme Court-ordered demolition of informal structures on Aravalli land protected under the Punjab Land Preservation Act, mid-2021.
zones.expected_change: Built-up structures removed (demolition), surface turns to rubble and bare earth
zones.citation: Supreme Court of India, Municipal Corporation of Faridabad v. Khori Gaon Residents Welfare Association, SLP (C) 7220-7221/2017, orders of 2021

zones.name: Kot / Dhauj, Faridabad Aravallis
zones.event: Reported illegal stone quarrying in the Aravalli hills despite the mining ban, 2021-2024.
zones.expected_change: Vegetation loss and new bare rock / soil (mining)
zones.citation: NGT OA 362/2022 (Aravalli Bachao Citizens Movement v. Union of India), as reported; unverified

zones.name: Yamuna floodplain (Zone O), Delhi
zones.event: DDA clearance of encroachments (nurseries, structures, farms) on about 401 ha of Yamuna floodplain, 2023-2024.
zones.expected_change: Encroachments cleared: nurseries / farms / structures removed
zones.citation: Times of India, '401.4 hectares of floodplain freed from squatters on Yamuna riverbed', July 2024; NGT proceedings

data_source: REAL Sentinel-2 L2A (Earth Search STAC); Sentinel-1 RTC where available
